# Case Study: Onboarding Redesign

How a focused onboarding rework lifted activation for a B2B analytics product.

## Context

New workspaces frequently stalled before connecting their first data source, capping
activation and downstream retention.

## Work

Problem: 60% of new workspaces never connected a data source, so they never reached value.
Action: Instrumented the funnel, then rebuilt onboarding around a guided first-connection flow with sane defaults.
Result: Raised first-source connection rate from 40% to 68% within one quarter.

Problem: Support was flooded with repetitive setup questions during trials.
Action: Added contextual inline guidance and a self-serve troubleshooting checklist to the setup flow.
Result: Cut setup-related support tickets by 45% and shortened average trial-to-paid time by nine days.

## Reflection

The biggest lever was measuring the funnel before touching the UI — the data pointed
directly at the first-connection step.
